Sixteen Degrees Before Seven

SSF-MS6-L1-10001300-MSSCI6-RWS-MNA · MS Science Grade 6 · Atmospheric and Oceanic Circulation; Regional Climates
THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The wind board

As you record, the four numbers fill in. Find the gap between two places to see which wind is stronger.

THE SCENE
Your class runs the weather desk at the port for one day. You are alone in the radio room. The boats leave at seven, and the wind board must be done first. You need four numbers, and four people each have one.
THE HISTORY
For a long time, sailors in Oman watched the wind. For half the year it blew one way. Then it turned and blew back. They called it mawsim, the Arabic word for season.
